transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I’m here because I feel like I can’t really settle in my own body anymore. It’s especially bad when I’m supposed to sit quietly and deal with paperwork or make household plans with someone. I just feel restless and unable to stay with it.
Do you feel anxious or experience physical symptoms like a racing heart or sweating when you're trying to handle paperwork or make household plans?

I’m not sure I’d call it anxiety. I haven’t really noticed things like sweating or my heart racing. It’s more that I just can’t stay with the task, but I don’t know if there’s a physical panic feeling with it.
When you're trying to handle paperwork or make household plans, do you feel any kind of anxiety or inner tension, even if it's not paired with sweating or a racing heart?

Yeah, I guess “inner tension” is closer than anxiety. It’s like I can’t settle in my own body when I’m supposed to sit quietly and do paperwork or talk through household plans. I just feel restless and like I need to get away from it or move around.
Do you feel this inner tension and restlessness in situations other than paperwork or household planning, like in social settings or when you’re alone?

Mostly it shows up when I’m expected to sit still and focus on something like paperwork or making plans at home with someone. I don’t notice it as clearly in every situation, but those are the times where I really feel like I can’t settle in my body.
When you’re working on paperwork or making household plans, do you find it hard to focus or stay concentrated on what you’re doing?

Yes. I can start out okay, like with a planning email or even a chapter in a book, but after a few minutes I’ll realize I’m just staring at the same paragraph and none of it actually went in. I have to keep rereading, and it’s hard to stay with it.
Do you find it hard to focus or feel restless in situations other than paperwork or household planning, like during conversations, reading, or while working on other tasks?

Yeah, it’s not only paperwork. Reading is a big one too. I can sit down with a book chapter and feel like I’m starting fine, but a few minutes later I realize I’ve been staring at the same paragraph and nothing actually went in. Same kind of thing can happen with an email that needs planning or attention.
Do you also have trouble focusing or feeling restless during other activities, like conversations, watching a movie, or completing tasks at work?

Yes, especially with reading or anything that takes sustained attention. I can sit down with a planning email or a chapter of a book and think I’m doing fine, but after a few minutes I realize I’m just staring at the same paragraph and none of it has really gone in.
Do you also have trouble focusing or feel restless during activities like conversations, watching a movie, or completing tasks at work, or is it mostly when you're reading or doing paperwork?

It’s mostly the reading or paperwork type things for me—the stuff where I have to stay with it mentally. Like I can start a planning email or a book chapter okay, but then a few minutes later I’m just staring at the same paragraph and realize none of it actually went in.
Do you also have trouble focusing during conversations or tasks at work, or does this mainly happen with reading and paperwork?

Mainly with reading and paperwork-type things. Like if I’m trying to read a chapter or write a planning email, I can start out okay, but after a few minutes I realize I’m just staring at the same paragraph and it hasn’t really sunk in.
Do you also find it hard to focus or feel restless during work tasks or conversations, or is it mostly limited to reading and paperwork?

It’s mostly the reading and paperwork side of things. Like, I can sit down to write a planning email or read a chapter and feel like I’m starting okay, but then a few minutes later I realize I’m just looking at the same paragraph and it hasn’t gone in.
Do you also find it hard to focus or feel restless during conversations or while completing tasks at work, or does this only happen with reading and paperwork?

It’s really more the reading and paperwork kind of stuff. I can sit down with a planning email or a chapter in a book and start off okay, but after a few minutes I’ll catch myself staring at the same paragraph and realize none of it actually went in.
Do you ever have trouble focusing or feel restless during work tasks or conversations, or does this only happen when you're reading or doing paperwork?

It’s mostly when I’m reading or doing paperwork. Like I can start a planning email or a chapter of a book okay, but then a few minutes later I realize I’m just staring at the same paragraph and none of it actually went in.
Do you ever find it hard to focus or feel restless during work tasks or conversations, or does this only happen when you're reading or doing paperwork?

It’s mostly the reading or paperwork type of thing. I can start out fine with, say, a planning email or a chapter in a book, but after a few minutes I’ll realize I’ve just been staring at the same paragraph and none of it has actually gone in.
Looking back, did you have similar issues with staying focused or feeling restless when you were a child, like in school or while doing homework?

Yes, looking back, it was definitely there when I was little. In elementary school I was always the kid with the messy desk, forgetting permission slips, and getting notes sent home that I talked out of turn or couldn’t seem to stay in my seat.
